subheader: The billing rules in full, so nobody has to ring up and ask.
lead: Everything below applies from the day it is asked for. Nothing here needs a support ticket, and none of it changes at renewal.
note: These rules apply to plans bought directly. A practice on a written offer follows the terms of that offer for its stated term; where the two differ, the offer wins.

rules.title: We are moving up a plan mid-month. What happens?
rules.bodytext: The new plan takes effect the moment you choose it, and the invoice at the end of the month carries both: the old plan up to the changeover day and the new one from it, each counted in days. Nothing is charged twice and nothing has to be cancelled first.

rules.title: And moving down?
rules.bodytext: A downgrade takes effect at the end of the current billing period, not immediately. You keep what you have paid for until then. We ask for it in writing — an e-mail is enough — because a downgrade can remove practitioner accounts, and that is not something to trigger with one click.

rules.title: We took on a new therapist on the 14th. What is billed?
rules.bodytext: The account is charged from the day it is created, counted in days against the band rate. An account switched off mid-month is charged to the day it was switched off. We do not round up to a full month in either direction.

rules.title: How much notice do we have to give?
rules.bodytext: One month, to the end of a calendar month. A notice that arrives on the 3rd of March ends the plan on the 30th of April. There is no minimum term to run out first and no automatic renewal for a year.

rules.title: What happens to our data when we leave?
rules.bodytext: You get a full export — patients, appointments, documents, invoices — as CSV and PDF, free, whenever you ask for it. We keep the practice readable for 60 days after the last day so a late request is still possible, and then delete it. The deletion is confirmed to you in writing.

rules.title: When is a refund due?
rules.bodytext: Within the first 60 days, for any reason, on the plan price you have paid — see the guarantee. After that, a monthly plan simply stops at the end of the notice period and is not refunded, and a yearly invoice is not refunded pro rata. One-off work already delivered is never refunded, but it is also never charged before it is done.
